content.text:
**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred position met) — no redline proposed.**

- **No restrictive covenant binds Sanofi.** Articles III, XIII (13.3 RevMed covenants; 13.4 mutual covenants — debarment, compliance, pharmacovigilance only) and XV contain no undertaking limiting what Sanofi or its Affiliates may develop, acquire, buy or sell. The licence field is "any and all uses" (§1.36), so there is no field-of-use limit either.
- **The only exclusivity runs in our favour.** §3.5(a) restricts *RevMed* and its Affiliates from SHP2 Inhibitor work outside the Collaboration — a Vendor-side restriction we do not flag.
- **§12.2(d) is a termination trigger, not a non-compete.** RevMed may terminate if Sanofi pursues a Competing Product (with a cure election for Sanofi); Sanofi is never prohibited from doing so. Under the rule boundaries, that consequence sits with the termination provisions (effects at §12.3(c), p0500) and is not double-flagged here.
- **§15.2 change-of-control conditions (p0614)** are mutual IP-firewall conditions for assignment treatment, not a prohibition on competing programmes.
- Noted for the file, not as a deviation: the "Competing Product" definition (§1.20) is partly redacted, so its criteria should be confirmed against the disclosure schedules.
